review.status_note: reviewed: approved by the owner on 2026-11-17 for the v3 release (49 entries measured on the v3 path, 3 v2 rows within 2x kept, gemma-4-31b provisional at 9 calls)
limitations: v2 means were measured on the v2 pool with a 16,384-token answer budget; v3 adds code questions and raises budgets to each entry's max_tokens, so provisional completion means are likely low for long reasoners.
Effort factors are a stated assumption, not a measurement.
